title: Random training samples (control)
explanation: Random training samples of the same size and classes: is the given one better than chance?
settings: 100 samples drawn from all objects with the training sample's size and class counts, seeds 42 … 141; each fitted and the other objects classified. The percentile ranks the given sample among them.
description: An evaluation design on the article's split files (ADR-095): every method of the comparison with fixed settings, the classified objects without their class. Percentages with two decimals.
